svg.title: How the house works: guest, Node server, owner
svg.desc: An animated diagram. A guest order moves from the browser to a dependency-free Node server, then to the owner desk. A reviewed WhatsApp draft is handed to the guest. Menu, reservations and opt-in measurements live in a JSON store.

g.text: A guest order, a table request, and the desk that answers.
Choose dishes, spice and extras. The bag
stays in the browser until review.
Re-prices the order, validates hours and
keeps the menu and reservation state.
Confirms tables, edits the menu and reads
The guest sends it. Nothing is charged or accepted automatically.
Catalog, reservations and opt-in measurements survive restarts.
Static hosting keeps the story, menu, bag and WhatsApp draft. The server adds the live menu, reservation inbox, dashboard, measurements and runtime SEO.
